description: This header defines the VariableHooksInterface class, which provides an abstract interface for variable hook implementations in PyTorch's autograd system. It includes method declarations for accessing and modifying TensorBase data, gradient functions, hooks, and other autograd-related properties, as well as functions to set and get variable hooks.

classes.name: VariableHooksInterface
classes.description: An interface class providing hook mechanisms for autograd variable operations, enabling customization of tensor behavior in autograd workflows.

methods.name: tensor_data
methods.description: Returns the raw tensor data from a TensorBase object.

methods.name: variable_data
methods.description: Returns the variable data associated with a TensorBase object.

methods.name: grad_fn
methods.description: Returns the gradient function node associated with a TensorBase.

methods.name: _register_hook
methods.description: Registers a hook function to a TensorBase, returning an unsigned identifier.

methods.name: remove_hook
methods.description: Removes a previously registered hook identified by its position.

methods.name: is_view
methods.description: Checks if the TensorBase is a view.

methods.name: base
methods.description: Returns the base tensor of a view.

methods.name: name
methods.description: Returns the name associated with a TensorBase.

methods.name: is_leaf
methods.description: Checks if the TensorBase is a leaf tensor.

methods.name: output_nr
methods.description: Returns the output number of a TensorBase.

methods.name: set_data
methods.description: Sets new data for a TensorBase.

methods.name: data
methods.description: Returns the data contained in a TensorBase.

methods.name: _version
methods.description: Returns the version number of a TensorBase.

methods.name: retain_grad
methods.description: Retains the gradient of a TensorBase.

methods.name: retains_grad
methods.description: Checks if a TensorBase retains its gradient.

methods.name: _backward
methods.description: Performs the backward pass for autograd.

methods.name: requires_grad_
methods.description: Sets the requires_grad flag for a TensorBase.

methods.name: basic_autograd_not_implemented_fallback
methods.description: Fallback for autograd functions not implemented.

methods.name: grad_dtype
methods.description: Returns the gradient data type for a TensorBase.

methods.name: set_grad_dtype
methods.description: Sets the gradient data type for a TensorBase.

methods.name: VariableHooksRegisterer(VariableHooksInterface * hooks)
